comment: Pinned assets of the /live page. Files are gitignored; `npm run live:sync` copies them into public/ and checks every SHA-256. The fc10 files come from the folder in FC10_DIR (default: HandsUp-models/fc10 next to the repo), made by ml/export/fc10_onnx.py and ml/export/fc10_fixtures.py.

ort.note: Verified in node_modules by live:sync; Vite emits it as a hashed asset (imported with ?url).
